scope: Post-training evaluation of the seed-100 three-task no-memory control. Use existing validation scores and add only the paired FP32 historical probes, automatically after the SLAKE endpoint finishes.
gate: Macro average of old-task correct-to-wrong rates, using all four orders for MedBook and forced binary answers for PathVQA, at least 0.10, or macro final-minus-peak accuracy <= -0.03. Candidate pools excluded from both probe denominators.
